import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

wt=Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
expected="25023d0b9d28b0d2cccec9022ca5cc470124d749"

def run(args):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout

head=run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).strip()
status=run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).strip()
if head!=expected or status:
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected state head={head} status={status!r}")

for rel in ["README.md","ROADMAP.md",".github/workflows/ci.yml"]:
    p=wt/rel
    print(f"=== {rel} ===")
    lines=p.read_text().splitlines()
    for n,line in enumerate(lines,1):
        if rel!="README.md" or n<=260:
            print(f"{n:04d}: {line}")

print("=== benchmark/soak references ===")
proc=subprocess.run(
    ["git","grep","-ni","soak\|latency\|benchmark\|chaos\|stress\|duration_seconds\|started_at_utc\|finished_at_utc","--","src","tests","tools"],
    cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True
)
print(proc.stdout)
